description: Create a new object (a locator-bound UI element) in the shared Object Repository. `objectType` (e.g. "WEB", "ANDROID") is REQUIRED and STRUCTURAL — it selects the object template and cannot be changed after creation (see object_update). `locators` is the set of captured selector strategies for this element. GET-OR-CREATE by NAME (case-insensitive): if an object with the same name already exists, this reuses it — updating its locators in place if they differ — instead of creating a duplicate. Requires a live connection (qa_connect).

locators.description: Captured locator strategies for this element.

unique.description: true makes this the object's DEFAULT locator (the one the UI marks as default and the executor uses first); only one default exists — it is cleared on the others. object_update also has `defaultLocator` (by name).

name.description: Display name for the object (the UI's "Name" column).

objectType.description: Object type / technology, e.g. "WEB", "ANDROID", "IOS", "DESKTOP". Required, and fixed once created.

name: object_create
title: Create a new object in the Object Repository
